game.name: CELESTE Classic
game.rules:
Celeste is a game made for the PICO-8 VM. Playable in browser [[here]](http://www.lexaloffle.com/bbs/?tid=2145). See [[Resources]](https://www.speedrun.com/celestep8/resources) for standalone versions, as well as the game's practice mod.

---

# General Game Rules  

* Reach the summit.  
* No pause buffering, i.e., pausing for the sake of timing inputs.
* For PICO-8 USERS ONLY: Cart modifications that affect visuals or gameplay are prohibited. Examples of legal modifications include:
    * Changing the default setting for toggleable parameters like screenshake.
    * Outputting information for auto-splitters.  

---  

## Run Submission Rules  

* When submitting times, only fill out IGT. Leave real time blank.  
* If submitting an individual level run ending with .000 seconds, make sure to type "000" under the milliseconds box for **both** IGT and real time. This ensures that the site actually displays the ".000".
* Slower runs **may** be accepted with simple photographic proof but it's recommended to record your runs as faster runs strictly require video proof.
    * Video proof is required for all individual level runs.
    * A GIF recorded with PICO-8's built-in GIF recording constitutes video proof if it sufficiently captures the run.
* Submit under the correct platform.  
    * Submit runs played in browser under "Web".  
    * Submit runs played on PICO-8 software under "PC".  
    * Submit runs played on the 2018 release of Celeste under the platform you're on, **and** also check the box for emulator.

categories.name: No Diagonal Dashes
categories.rules:
# Category Rules
See "Game Rules" for universal rules.

* Reach the summit by any in-game means without diagonally dashing.

categories.name: No Springs
categories.rules:
# Category Rules
See "Game Rules" for universal rules.

* Reach the summit by any in-game means without bouncing off of any springs.

* Spring bounce check per level is reset on death.

categories.name: All Crumble Blocks
categories.rules:
# Category Rules
See "Game Rules" for universal rules.

* Reach the summit by any in-game means while crumbling every crumble block.

* Crumble check per level is reset on death.

categories.name: All Balloons Twice
categories.rules:
# Category Rules
See "Game Rules" for universal rules.

* Reach the summit by any in-game means while popping all balloons twice. Not once, not three times, but exactly twice.

* Balloon count per level is reset on death.

* Go for maximum swag. Stay off the ground as much as possible.  This isn't actually a rule, but we judge based on style here.  

---
